option_relations.rationale: Frontotemporal dementia and parkinsonism-17 due to TBK1 gene variant is a specific type of Frontotemporal Dementia (FTD).
Frontotemporal dementia and parkinsonism-17 due to TBK1 gene variant can present with features overlapping with ALS-FTD, and is considered part of the broader spectrum.
Frontotemporal dementia and parkinsonism-17 due to TBK1 gene variant is a form of FTLD that can include motor neuron disease features.
The leaf 'Frontotemporal dementia and parkinsonism-17 due to TBK1 gene variant' directly corresponds to an ALS-FTD spectrum disorder related to TBK1, as described in the option.
